subject: Pilot credits & extension / burn-rate check - Acme.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-08T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — pilot credits / burn-rate

Thanks again for taking the time today, Alex — great conversation. Quick recap and agreed next steps: 

- Pilot scope: 2-week proof-of-concept for Acme.ai search assistant (reranking + chat).
- Models: medium latency-open model (rwkv-7b q4) for chat + dedicated reranker.
- Objective: validate quality and cost at expected traffic before committing to Dedicated.

Action items we agreed:
1) Redwood to provision $10k in trial credits immediately to unblock integration and initial tests (we discussed possible extension based on burn).
2) Acme to share expected token volumes (daily active users, avg tokens per session, peak concurrency) so we can model unit economics and recommend config.
3) Schedule a mid-pilot check-in (end of week 1) to review burn rate and suggest optimizations (batching/quant profiles).

On credits: we can approve the initial $10k now. If burn shows you need more runway, I can submit a one-time extension up to $15k (manager approval required) — we'll decide after the week-1 check-in.

Please send the usage estimates and your preferred time for the end-of-week check.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme.ai>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>
Date: 2026-04-08T18:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — pilot credits / burn-rate

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and for the $10k provisioning, appreciated.

Attached a quick sheet with our initial estimates (usage_estimates.xlsx). Key numbers: 
- Estimated DAU for pilot: 500 users
- Avg tokens per session: 1,200 (prompt+response)
- Sessions per DAU per day: 2
- Expected pilot duration: 14 days
- Peak day multiplier: 1.5x (we plan load test week 2)

That puts us roughly at: 500 * 2 * 1,200 * 14 = 16.8M tokens baseline, ~25.2M tokens at peak.

Budget guidance: we are targeting an initial budget of $/1M tokens between $60-$90 to make the economics work for a go/no-go decision. Can you confirm what unit economics we should expect on the rwkv-7b q4 path with batching and KV caching enabled? Also we'd like to request an extension to $20k in total credits if the week-1 burn looks reasonable — would you be able to approve that or should we plan for formal manager approval?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

—Alex
Alex Jenkins
Head of Product, Acme.ai
alex.jenkins@acme.ai | (617) 555-0199

Attachment: usage_estimates.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-09T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — pilot credits / burn-rate

Great — thanks for the estimates and the file. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Unit economics: on rwkv-7b q4 with conservative batching and prefix caching we typically target $65-80 per 1M tokens at the volumes you shared. With aggressive batching and KV cache (session reuse) you can see ~10-25% improvements. Exact depends on your concurrency and average sequence lengths during inference.
- Credit extension: I can provision the initial $10k now. For a one-time bump to $20k I need to route to my manager for approval; I will start that process immediately and loop you in. If you can commit to a week-1 check-in data point (timestamped usage export) we can fast-track approval.

Dylan — can you run a quick back-of-envelope on expected burn for baseline and peak given Acme's numbers and include recommended optimizations (batch size, KV policy, quant profile)? If you can drop a short XLS with a conservative and aggressive scenario that would help me make the case.

Alex — are you available Thu 4/09 3pm PT or Fri 4/10 10am PT for a 30m check-in?

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@acme.ai>
Date: 2026-04-10T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Pilot economics back-of-envelope (baseline vs peak)

Forwarding my quick calc + recommendations.

Summary (all numbers approximate):
- Baseline tokens (16.8M) -> expected spend w/ rwkv-7b q4 and conservative batching: ~$1,100-$1,350 per million -> baseline cost: $18.5k - $22.7k over 14 days.
- Peak tokens (25.2M) -> spend: $27.7k - $34.0k.

Notes:
- These unit rates assume continuous session reuse (KV cache hit ~30-40%) and batching at 4-8 in production. If you enable more aggressive batching during background reranking (where latency isn't strict) you can push unit to low-$1k / 1M tokens.
- We recommend: 1) enable KV cache for chat sessions, 2) use a smaller reranker for pre-filter then rerank top-K with larger model, 3) start with q4 quant and evaluate q3 for hot paths if quality needs improvement.

I attached a tiny sheet with conservative/aggressive columns. If Marissa will push for the $20k extension, this calc supports that ask (baseline likely burns through $10k within the first week by our estimate).

Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pilot_burn_calc.xlsx
